title: The Evolution of Influence Through Endogenous Link Formation
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Agent-based simulation of endogenous link formation between experts and non-experts; results are summaries of simulation runs.
design_notes: Code/EndoNetworkMain.cpp (ABM simulator) and Data/*.r scripts that summarize simulation output (R3_Basemodel.r, StudyD.r, etc.). No empirical panel or treatment timing.
data_files_note: Simulation outputs and configuration files shipped.
data_provenance_note: The paper's own agent-based simulation outputs (no empirical data).
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); design taken from the OpenAlex abstract and code. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
